steps.title: Gather reagents and materials
steps.instruction: Collect all required reagents and consumables with the following catalog numbers: HA‑ubiquitin‑vinyl sulfone (Boston Biochem, U‑212), 26S proteasome (Ub‑VS treated) (Ubiquigent, 65‑1020‑010), recombinant His₆‑T7‑UBP6 (or other DUB), poly‑Ub (Ub₃‑7) K48‑linked (Boston Biochem, UC‑220), poly‑Ub (Ub₃‑7) K63‑linked (Boston Biochem, UC‑320), di‑Ub K48‑linked (Boston Biochem, UC‑200B), di‑Ub K63‑linked (Boston Biochem, UC‑300B), UltraPure Tris (Invitrogen, 15504‑020), MgCl₂·6H₂O (Sigma‑Aldrich, M2670), ATP (Sigma‑Aldrich, A26209), DTT (Sigma‑Aldrich, 1114740005), glycerol (Sigma‑Aldrich, G5516), SDS (Sigma‑Aldrich, L3771), bromophenol blue (Sigma‑Aldrich, B8026), anti‑HA antibody (ThermoFisher, 26183), anti‑ubiquitin antibody (Santa Cruz, sc‑8017), anti‑T7 antibody (Millipore, 69522), SuperSignal West Pico PLUS chemiluminescent substrate (ThermoFisher, 34577), double‑distilled H₂O, 15 % SDS‑PAGE gel (compatible with Bio‑Rad Mini‑PROTEAN), and any required secondary antibodies.

steps.title: Prepare 10× DUB labelling buffer
steps.instruction: Make a stock solution (store at –20 °C) containing 500 mM Tris pH 7.4, 50 mM MgCl₂, 10 mM DTT, and 10 mM ATP.

steps.title: Prepare 10× deubiquitination buffer
steps.instruction: Make a stock solution (store at –20 °C) containing 500 mM Tris pH 7.4, 50 mM MgCl₂, 10 mM DTT, and 50 mM ATP.

steps.title: Prepare 2× SDS‑PAGE loading buffer
steps.instruction: Make a solution (store at room temperature; add DTT fresh before use) containing 20 % glycerol, 120 mM Tris pH 6.8, 4 % SDS, 0.02 % bromophenol blue, and 100 mM DTT.

steps.title: Set up HA‑UbVS labelling reaction
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 1 µL 10× DUB labelling buffer, 5 µL 700 nM DUB, 1.25 µL 80 nM 26S proteasome (if required), 1 µL 7 µM HA‑UbVS, and 1.75 µL ddH₂O to a total volume of 10 µL. Prepare control reactions by omitting individual components and replacing them with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Incubate HA‑UbVS labelling mix
steps.instruction: Incubate the 10 µL reactions for 30 min at 22 °C (room temperature) or in a heat block set to 22 °C.

steps.title: Add loading buffer and denature
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL 2× SDS‑PAGE loading buffer to each reaction, then incubate 10 min at 70 °C in a heat block.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and western blot (HA‑UbVS)
steps.instruction: Load samples onto a 15 % SDS‑PAGE gel (compatible with Bio‑Rad Mini‑PROTEAN), perform electrophoresis, transfer to a membrane, and probe with anti‑HA antibody (1:5000) to detect free HA‑UbVS (~9.8 kDa) and HA‑UbVS‑labelled DUB. Also probe with the appropriate DUB‑specific or epitope‑tag antibody at its recommended dilution. Visualise using a standard chemiluminescence imaging system (e.g., film or CCD) after incubation with SuperSignal West Pico PLUS substrate.

steps.title: Set up in‑vitro deubiquitination assay
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 1 µL 10× deubiquitination buffer, 1 µL 200 nM DUB, 1 µL 12.5 nM 26S proteasome (if required), 1 µL 4 µM ubiquitin substrate, and 6 µL ddH₂O to a total volume of 10 µL. Prepare control reactions by omitting individual components and replacing them with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Incubate deubiquitination reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the 10 µL reactions at 30 °C for the desired time (2–16 h for His₆‑T7‑UBP6; adjust according to the DUB and substrate used).

steps.title: Add loading buffer and denature (deubiquitination)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL 2× SDS‑PAGE loading buffer to each reaction, then incubate 10 min at 70 °C in a heat block.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and western blot (deubiquitination)
steps.instruction: Load samples onto a 15 % SDS‑PAGE gel, perform electrophoresis, transfer to a membrane, and probe with anti‑ubiquitin antibody (at its specific dilution) to detect the original ubiquitin chain substrate and any lower‑order ubiquitin species generated by DUB activity. Visualise using a standard chemiluminescence system after incubation with SuperSignal West Pico PLUS substrate.
